text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A proposal for easing restrictions on trade in elephant products and ivory comes up for debate at the ongoing CITES conference on Tuesday afternoon.

- Davison Matanganyidze, who fled to the United States a year ago after police opened a probe of alleged misappropriation of funds at his Former Access To Capital company, has been arrested after arriving back in Zimbabwe.
- Hundreds of Zimbabweans and other nationals have lost cars bought from South Africans who later reported them as stolen allegedly as part of fraudulent insurance claims.
- A labour tribunal ruled on Monday that workers at Standard Chartered Bank were not entitled to any bonus besides what they had already been paid for 1996.
